name: auto-board-task
description: Process the top Todo card on a GitHub Project (v2) board end-to-end: pull the board into a task-agent tasks.yml, claim the top Todo card (moved to In Progress), run task-agent against that task to open a PR, sync the PR back so the card moves to In Review, then review the PR with the `pr-reviewer` agent and apply fixes for actionable review comments. Bundles the `gh-project-sync` reconciler skill (used twice in the chain) and composes it with `task-agent` and the `pr-reviewer` and `review-fixer` skill wrappers (shipped by `task-agent`) via the `workflow` skill — `task-agent` and `workflow` must also be installed.
